provenance: Drawn from the engine's own map and Today, exported unedited from a collection of 1,662 papers built on November 3, 2026: three watches' papers from arXiv, and three searches' from the sources they asked. The papers are real, and so are the day's runs that found the new ones; when the watches' earlier papers were collected is laid out from each paper's publication date.

papers.title: GEAR: Generative Editing for Scene-Conditioned Outfit Retrieval for VR Travel
papers.authors: Gia-Huy Dinh, Thinh-Phuc Nguyen, Thanh-Hai Nguyen, Lam-Huy Nguyen-Ngoc, Hoang-Bach Nguyen-Phan, Nam-Quan Nguyen, Minh-Triet Tran, Trung-Nghia Le
papers.abstract_lede: In virtual environments, choosing appropriate outfits requires contextual harmony with surrounding scenes, yet bridging the visual gap between 3D ambient views and catalog garment assets remains challenging.

papers.title: Evaluating Synthetic Skin Lesion Images for Classifier Training: A Safety-Aware Algorithm
papers.authors: Amindu Kumarasinghe, Vinh Bui, Reza Ghanbarzadeh
papers.abstract_lede: Skin cancer classifiers need large sets of annotated images, which are scarce, especially for rare lesion types. AI-generated images can fill the gap, but a generator produces images of widely varying quality, so selecting which images to retain is important.

papers.title: Probing Local Conditional Fit for Diffusion Model Membership Inference
papers.authors: ByungHee Cha, Naoki Murata, Yuhta Takida, Jong Chul Ye, Yuki Mitsufuji
papers.abstract_lede: Membership inference determines whether a candidate example was used to train a text-to-image diffusion model and is an important tool for auditing training-data use.

papers.title: W2A: Distilling World Priors into Action Models for Real-Time Robotic Control
papers.authors: Xiaopeng Zhang, Yongjin Mu, Yueyang Weng, Chengzhi Zhao, Yanjie Li
papers.abstract_lede: World Action Models (WAMs) have recently shown great promise in robotic control, benefiting from the future imagination capability of large-scale pretrained video models.

papers.title: Latent Diffusion-GAN: Adversarial Learning in the Autoencoded Latent Space
papers.authors: U-Chae Jun, Jaeeun Ko, Jiwoo Kang
papers.abstract_lede: Diffusion models are powerful generative frameworks for producing high-quality images by denoising latent variables from random noise.

papers.title: Train the Sampler You Run: Few-Step Masked Diffusion Language Models via Mixture-Likelihood Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_lede: When a masked diffusion language model is sampled in a few parallel steps in a random order, the model actually run is a mixture over reveal plans, while cross-entropy training fits token conditionals rather than this mixture.

papers.title: Disen-Forcing: Disentangling Semantic Anchoring from Motion for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Zhengyang Yu, Akio Hayakawa, Masato Ishii, Qingtao Yu, Xuesong Li, Takashi Shibuya, Yuki Mitsufuji, Jing Zhang
papers.abstract_lede: Autoregressive video diffusion models (AR-VDMs) enable real-time, long-horizon video generation but degrade rapidly once the inference horizon outruns the training horizon, due to compounding exposure bias.

papers.title: Balancing Representations by Identifying and Generating Under-represented Data
papers.authors: Filipe Laitenberger, Hirokatsu Kataoka, Yuki Asano, Cees Snoek, Mohammadreza Salehi
papers.abstract_lede: Self-supervised learning inherits the coverage of its source data. When an unlabeled corpus is long-tailed, the representation becomes dense around frequent modes and thin where coverage is weak. Objectives for long-tailed SSL reweight the images already in the corpus and add no new ones.

papers.title: Generative diffusion in long-range correlated landscapes: Speciation cascade and the foam structure of the score
papers.authors: Jerome Garnier-Brun, Giulio Biroli, Marc Mézard, Jean-Philippe Bouchaud
papers.abstract_lede: While state of the art for image and video generation, the fundamental reasons for the effectiveness of generative diffusion remain unclear.

papers.title: Efficient Hybrid Distillation: Synergizing Score and Adversarial Objectives for One-Step Diffusion
papers.authors: Fei Peng, Junqiang Wu, Haoxian Tan, Jun Zhou, Jie Hu, Xiaoming Wei, Jie Guo, Xiu Li
papers.abstract_lede: Numerous distillation methods have been developed to accelerate diffusion models. Recent research indicates that hybrid strategies---blending different paradigms---yield superior results compared to single-method approaches.

papers.title: When Optimization Meets Human Intent: Human-Centered Diffusion Model Optimization
papers.abstract_lede: Diffusion models are evolving from general tools into personalized systems that adapt to user needs through fine-tuning and guidance. However, diffusion optimization mainly targets measurable objectives such as aesthetics, rarely examining whether they align with human intent.

papers.title: Online Class Posteriors for Interpretable and Controllable Discrete Diffusion
papers.authors: Felix Koulischer, Gianni Van De Velde, François Remy, Chris Develder, Thomas Demeester
papers.abstract_lede: Discrete diffusion models remain far less understood than their continuous counterparts, despite recent breakthroughs across modalities, most notably in text.

papers.title: Fracture-Bench: A Controlled Benchmark Suite for Machine Learning Surrogates in Phase-Field Fracture Mechanics
papers.authors: Meenu Krishnan U., Maryam Hakimzadeh, Indrashish Saha, Meer Mehran Rashid, Lori Graham-Brady, Somdatta Goswami
papers.abstract_lede: Machine-learning surrogates are increasingly proposed to replace phase-field fracture simulations in many-query tasks such as uncertainty quantification, inverse analysis and design. Little controlled evidence shows which architectures are reliable, for which fracture problems and how far beyond their training data.

papers.title: Generalizable Equivariant Diffusion Models for Non-Abelian Lattice Gauge Theory: Analytical Foundations and Numerical Scaling Tests
papers.authors: Gert Aarts, Diaa E. Habibi, Andreas Ipp, David I. Müller, Thomas R. Ranner, Lingxiao Wang, Wei Wang, Qianteng Zhu
papers.abstract_lede: Gauge-equivariant diffusion models can be used to generate ensembles of field configurations in non-abelian lattice gauge theories. Previously, we demonstrated the feasibility of modeling these theories by combining L-CNN-based diffusion models with the Metropolis-adjusted annealed Langevin algorithm (MAALA).

papers.title: Structured Visual Landscape: Generating Preferred Representations in Biological and Artificial Neural Networks
papers.authors: Yusong Zhao, Edgar Y. Walker, Hao Wang, Mi Lu
papers.abstract_lede: Understanding how neurons respond to visual stimulus is an important question in both deep learning and neuroscience. It has significant implications for enhancing the interpretability of black-box artificial neural networks and for understanding the visual representation in the human brain.

papers.title: Control Foundation Models across Changing Block Diagrams: Generalizing Time-Series Prediction to Dynamic Graphs
papers.authors: Yuji Okamoto, Kenta Hoshino, Masaki Inoue
papers.abstract_lede: In the prediction and control of physical systems, combining records from different experiments and operations is expected to supply information that no single experiment provides on its own.

papers.title: Resilient Cell-Free MIMO ISAC Under Uncertainties: An Impairment-Aware Graph Neural Network Framework
papers.authors: Oways Alsoloh, Robert-Jeron Reifert, Aymen Khaleel, Stefan Roth, Aydin Sezgin
papers.abstract_lede: Beamforming designs for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) in cell-free multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems face the challenge to stay reliable under uncertainties from both channel state information (CSI) as well as clutter.

papers.title: Certifying Graph Neural Networks Against Label and Structure Poisoning
papers.authors: Lukas Gosch, Xichuan Chen, Yan Scholten, Stephan Günnemann
papers.abstract_lede: Robust machine learning for graph-structured data has made significant progress against test-time attacks, yet certified robustness to poisoning - where adversaries manipulate the training data - remains largely underexplored.
